task.text: Write a list of three separate items (tea / bread / milk): ___
options: We bought tea bread and milk.
We bought tea bread and, milk.
We bought, tea bread and milk.

clarification: The displayed stem explicitly requires three separate items: tea / bread / milk. The old unqualified list could be read as two items including tea bread.
